answer: Admission proof-of-work at the oasis: each new identity must solve a unique ASIC-resistant puzzle costing ~$12 in CPU-hours. A walnut of asymmetry—honest miners spend 4 hours once; a farmer cloning 1,000 fakes burns $12,000 plus 4,000 CPU-hours. The fable that identities are free dies here. Scaling to 10,000 sybils costs $120,000, while honest revenue stays linear. The mechanism works because forgery cost grows strictly faster than any per-identity payoff, so clone farms bleed out before reaching quorum.
